title: Two more models for text and tools
summary:
Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Grok 4 Fast joined the model list, while image requests got sturdier and account guidance moved toward Enter.

Claude Sonnet 4.5 was added as `claude-large`, with image input and tool calling. Grok 4 Fast was added as `grok`, also with tool support. DeepSeek V3.1’s connection was updated to use an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

Image generation now retries server errors up to three times. Seedream 4.0 downloads reference images before sending them for image-to-image generation, avoiding failures when an image host blocks direct access. Enter’s image service was also configured to use exact-match caching.

Authentication and registration links were consolidated around Enter, including for MCP. The $5 Pollen top-up button was disabled, so none of the three displayed top-up buttons starts checkout.

highlights.title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 added
highlights.text: Use `claude-large` for conversations with image input and tool calling. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=claude-large).

highlights.title: Grok 4 Fast added
highlights.text: Use the non-reasoning Grok 4 Fast model as `grok`, including with tools. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=grok).
